title: erp.purchase_task.changed.v1
description: An approval task of a requisition (task type erp.purchase.requisition.approval) or an order (erp.purchase.order.approval), its complete state at each change, by version (be-protocol P17.15). The payload is the protocol's shared task contract; infra/workflow takes it from the publishers its deployment chose. The summary carries only fields its candidates may see: the number, the supplier's name, the total and the currency of an order; the number and the count of lines of a requisition.
